markscheme.html:
D

The centripetal force required for the car to move in a circle is provided by the static friction between the tyres and the road. The maximum speed is reached when the required centripetal force (mv^2/R) equals the maximum available static friction force (μN = μmg). Setting these equal and solving for v gives v = sqrt(μgR).
